info.title: API.SH: Kayak
info.description: The Kayak API from API.SH: public Kayak data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An airline's profile on Kayak: overall rating out of 10 and review count, lowest fare found, description, frequently asked questions (baggage, check-in, cabins), the cheapest fares on its popular routes, and its scheduled routes with flight times. Returns 404 for an airline Kayak has no page for.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kayak-airline

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The airline's two-letter IATA code, e.g. DL for Delta.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Car rentals for a city or airport and dates, from Kayak's own car search: car type and model, agency, total and per-day price, seats, bags, transmission, fuel, cancellation and mileage policy, Kayak's score and badges, pickup location, and every provider's offer with its booking link. 20 results per page in the chosen sort, with `total`, Kayak's filter lists (`filters`: every value with its count and lowest price) and `cheapest`. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (and `search_id` from the previous response to skip Kayak's search phase); `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kayak-cars

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City name (resolved with Kayak's location search), a Kayak city id, or a 3-letter airport code (LAX).

parameters.name: pickup_date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: dropoff_date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: pickup_hour
parameters.description: Hour of pick-up, 0-23 (default 12).

parameters.name: dropoff_hour
parameters.description: Hour of drop-off, 0-23 (default 12).

parameters.name: dropoff_location
parameters.description: Different drop-off city or airport (one-way rental). Default: the pick-up location.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: rank_a (recommended, default), price_a (cheapest), price_b, score_b (best score), distance_a (closest).

parameters.name: car_class
parameters.description: Comma-separated car classes, as in `filters.carclass` ids (small, medium, large, suv, van, luxury, convertible, pickuptruck, ...).

parameters.name: transmission
parameters.description: automatic or manual (ids from `filters.transmission`).

parameters.name: agency
parameters.description: Comma-separated rental agencies (ids from `filters.caragency`, e.g. hertz,avis).

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Seats (ids from `filters.carcapacity`).

parameters.name: policies
parameters.description: Policies (ids from `filters.carpolicies`, e.g. free cancellation, unlimited mileage).

parameters.name: eco
parameters.description: electric or hybrid (ids from `filters.ecoclass`).

parameters.name: payment
parameters.description: Payment type (ids from `filters.paymenttype`).

parameters.name: maker
parameters.description: Car maker (ids from `filters.carmaker`).

parameters.name: booking_sites
parameters.description: Booking sites (ids from `filters.bookingsites`).

parameters.name: pickup_type
parameters.description: Airport terminal / shuttle / off-airport (ids from `filters.pickupairportloctype`).

parameters.name: fs
parameters.description: Raw Kayak filter string, e.g. `carclass=suv;transmission=automatic` (combined with the filters above).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (20 results each). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: search_id
parameters.description: `search_id` from the previous response: the next page reuses that search (faster and lighter).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Cheapest flight deals from an origin to destinations around the world, as Kayak's explore map shows them: destination city, country and airport, lowest round-trip price, departure and return dates, number of stops, airline, flight duration, and coordinates. Sorted by price, cheapest first. Filter by budget, travel month, trip length and stops.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kayak-flight-deals

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Origin airport or city code (IATA), e.g. NYC or LHR.

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: Highest price to include, a whole amount in USD.

parameters.name: depart_month
parameters.description: Travel month as YYYY-MM (default: any time).

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Trip length in days (default: any).

parameters.name: stops
parameters.description: Maximum stops: 0 for nonstop only, 1 or 2 (default: any).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of destinations to return (default 100).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Only destinations in this country (two-letter code).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Fares for a one-way or round trip from Kayak's own flight search: price and booking options per provider, legs with segments, carriers, times, durations, stops and fare names. Optional cabin class, children (by age), infants in their own seat and a stops filter; when any of these is set, `applied_filters` echoes them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kayak-flights

parameters.name: return
parameters.description: Return date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a round trip.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Kayak sort, e.g. bestflight_a, price_a, duration_a.

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Adult travellers, 1-9 (default 1).

parameters.name: cabin
parameters.description: Cabin class for every leg (default economy).

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Children's ages (2-17), comma separated, one per child, e.g. 11,7.

parameters.name: infants_in_seat
parameters.description: Infants (under 2) with their own seat, 0-4. Adults, children and infants together at most 9.

parameters.name: stops
parameters.description: Only fares with these numbers of stops: 0 (nonstop), 1 (one stop), 2 (two or more), comma separated, e.g. 0,1.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A hotel's page on Kayak: name, star rating, address, phone, coordinates, description, amenities by category, policies and things to know, overall rating and review count, review summary, review tags, pros and cons, score distribution, scores from each review source, recent reviews (score, month, positive and negative comments), frequently asked questions, tips and nearby hotels. Pass dates to see the page for a given stay.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kayak-hotel

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Kayak hotel id (from /kayak/v1/hotels, or the number after -h in a hotel link). Either id or url is required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A kayak.com hotel details link, instead of id.

parameters.name: checkin
parameters.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: checkout
parameters.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Hotels and vacation rentals for a city and dates, from Kayak's own hotel search: name, stars, guest rating, every provider's price with the total, location and distance from the center, type, amenities, badges, description and photos. 30 properties per page (Kayak's own pages, in the chosen sort) with `total` for the city. Optional children (by age), star and nightly price filters, and Kayak's own filter string; the response then carries `children` and `filters_applied`. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (and `search_id` from the previous response to skip Kayak's search phase: one call instead of a new search); `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kayak-hotels

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City name (resolved with Kayak's location search) or a Kayak city id.

parameters.name: checkin
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: checkout
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Children's ages (0-17), comma separated, one per child, e.g. 8,5 (up to 6).

parameters.name: stars
parameters.description: Only these star ratings (1-5), comma separated, e.g. 4,5.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price per night (whole USD).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price per night (whole USD).

parameters.name: fs
parameters.description: Kayak's own filter string as it appears in a kayak.com hotels results address after `fs=` (filters separated by semicolons), for filters not named above.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: rank_a (recommended, default), price_a (cheapest), price_b, distance_a, userrating_b, stars_b.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (30 properties each, Kayak's own pages). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: search_id
parameters.description: `search_id` from the previous response: the next page reuses that search (faster and lighter). Without it a new search runs.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Kayak vacation packages for a destination
get.description:
Vacation packages (flight + hotel) for a destination as Kayak's packages page shows them: package prices by trip type (top, family, romantic, luxury, budget), the most popular, all-inclusive and last-minute hotel deals (price for the stay, dates, stars, score, reviews, features, address, coordinates), tips, description, the booking sites compared and other package destinations. Returns 404 for a destination Kayak has no packages page for.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kayak-packages

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: The destination as Kayak writes it in its packages links: a city, region or country, e.g. cancun, las-vegas, hawaii, mexico (other_destinations lists more). A kayak.com/packages/ link also works.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
